question: Which Indian city hosted the first ever three-day Fit India Carnival, a holistic health and fitness gathering festival, in March 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The city of **New Delhi** hosted the inaugural **Fit India Carnival** in **March 2025**. This **three-day** event was conceptualized as a premier **holistic health and fitness gathering** to celebrate and promote physical well-being among citizens.
 
• The carnival served as a massive community festival, bringing together **fitness experts**, **nutritionists**, **athletes**, and the general public to participate in various **health-centric activities** and **workshops**.
 
• The primary objective of the **Fit India Carnival** was to provide a platform for **holistic health**, covering aspects of **mental health**, **physical fitness**, and **balanced nutrition** through interactive sessions.
 
• The event featured diverse segments, including **yoga marathons**, **fitness challenges**, **live cooking demonstrations** for healthy recipes, and **exhibitions** of modern sports technology.
 
• By hosting this event in **New Delhi**, the government aimed to solidify the **national capital** as a hub for the **Fit India Movement**, encouraging urban populations to adopt more active lifestyles to combat **non-communicable diseases**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Fit India Movement:**
 
 
• The **Fit India Movement** is a nation-wide campaign in **India** that was launched by the **Prime Minister**, **Narendra Modi**, on **August 29, 2019**.
 
• The launch date coincides with the **National Sports Day**, which is celebrated to commemorate the birth anniversary of the legendary hockey player **Major Dhyan Chand**.
 
• The movement aims to encourage people to inculcate **physical activity** and **sports** in their everyday lives to improve their overall **health** and **longevity**.
 
 
 
• **Governance and Implementation:**
 
 
• The initiative is spearheaded by the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**, often working in coordination with the **Ministry of Education** and the **Ministry of Health and Family Welfare**.
 
• A **national committee** was formed to provide leadership and guidance, comprising government officials, members of the **Indian Olympic Association (IOA)**, national sports federations, and **fitness promoters**.
 
 
 
• **Key Components and Initiatives:**
 
 
• **Fit India School Week:** An initiative to encourage **schools** to integrate **fitness** into the daily routine of **students** and **staff**.
 
• **Fit India Freedom Run:** A popular event organized annually (often around **Independence Day**) to promote the habit of **running** and **walking** among the masses.
 
• **Fit India Quiz:** The **first-ever** national-level **fitness and sports quiz** for school students, designed to spread awareness about **India's sporting history** and **fitness culture**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Significance of the 2025 Carnival:** The **2025 Fit India Carnival** in **New Delhi** represents an evolution of the movement from awareness-based activities to experiential **community festivals**. It emphasizes the **holistic** approach, integrating **Traditional Indian medicine (Ayurveda)** and **Yoga** with modern **cardiovascular exercises**.
 
• **Location Advantage:** **New Delhi**, with its vast infrastructure such as the **Indira Gandhi Stadium** and **Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium**, provides the ideal **location** for large-scale **gatherings** and **sports festivals** of this nature.
 
• **Health Data Impact:** The movement is a strategic response to data showing a rise in **lifestyle-related ailments** in **India**. By promoting a **culture of fitness**, the government seeks to reduce the **economic burden** of healthcare and improve the **Productivity Index** of the **Indian workforce**.
